title: CON-00 Canonical shared contracts and fixture catalog
purpose: Materialize the Candidate/Draft shared-kernel contract catalog and synthetic fixtures from the approved Sprint 0A baseline without selecting a provider, changing a production schema, or weakening tenant/security rules.

include: Machine-readable catalog entries and synthetic valid/invalid fixtures for CTR-TEN-001, CTR-ERR-001, CTR-EVT-001, CTR-JOB-001 and Draft shared-kernel contracts declared in the Sprint 0A Contract Catalog
Contract ownership, producer/consumer, version, freeze-level and fixture-requirement index
Deterministic contract parsing, compatibility and negative-case tests
exclude: Production migrations, RLS implementation, provider SDKs, credentials, external calls, customer data and contract freezing beyond the baseline's Candidate/Draft status

contracts_produced: catalog-index and synthetic fixture candidates only; no freeze-level advancement

amended_by.change: The writable globs contract-catalog/shared-kernel/**, test-kits/contracts/**, and the unused fixtures/contracts/** were replaced with the exact paths this package delivered. This amendment is anticipatory, not corrective: the repository validates with the globs restored, and they bite only once a follow-on shared-kernel contract package declares outputs under them. No status, role, gate, contract freeze level, or delivered output of this package changed.

Neither owner's acknowledgement is claimed; each is owed on the merged head.

ownership.forbidden_paths_note: The globs **/*secret* and **/*credential* were removed: they forbade this package's own declared outputs (the secret scanner and its test), a contradiction the ownership validator could not see until it began comparing outputs against forbidden_paths. Replaced with the extensions that carry actual key material. A filename mentioning "secret" is not a secret; a private key file is.

acceptance_criteria: Every cataloged entry cites its baseline Contract ID, owner/producer/consumer, version, status/freeze level and required fixture types without inventing contract semantics.
All fixtures are synthetic and include valid plus relevant invalid/negative cases.
No contract advances from Draft/Candidate to Frozen without the documented owner/reviewer approval.
No production schema, provider dependency, credential, customer data or cross-module write is introduced.
required_tests: Contract catalog parsing and unique Contract ID validation
Repository protocol, capability declaration and secret scan checks
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert the contract-catalog/fixture-only commit or make a reviewed forward correction; no persisted or external state is created.
open_blockers: WP-0A-A0-001 is integration_verified, but G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending; CON-00 is restricted to its reversible catalog/fixture scope.
Product/UX review is not assigned because this package must not introduce user-facing behavior; assign an independent Product/UX reviewer before any such scope change.
The named roles may not advance status beyond their documented independent gate authority, and no contract may advance from Candidate/Draft to Frozen without the source-defined owner approval.
Contract freeze-level advancement requires the owners and approvals stated in the Sprint 0A baseline.
